conditional_modules.finance: Required for financial diagnosis; detailed pricing and funding review is deferred.
conditional_modules.operations: Only for evidenced process/inventory constraints; not a compulsory founder questionnaire.
conditional_modules.people: Only when role/capability constraint is evidenced; full people library is deferred.
conditional_modules.risk: Interrupt/escalate on material risk; a local risk owner must judge response.

reentry: Review can return to baseline, context or choice without pretending the graph is an irreversible stage ladder.
